items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Topics 36:1
items.html: (to the question) The human, hinted at in the totality of Atzilut, in AA and ABSAG, since the two upper thirds of the NH of AA ascended and joined to the HGT of AVI, at the time that they received the level of AB, and clothed the GAR of AA, at which time the two upper thirds of the NH became breasts — hence the breasts are above the Chazeh of AA. And so it is in the human. But the cattle and the animals, which do not include the totality of Atzilut but only the phases of details, therefore have their breasts below, in the place of the womb, which is the place of the pregnancy. (Part 1, Page 150, Items 78 to 80).
